name: Cha ca
summary: Cha ca is fish marinated, grilled, and finished at the table with dill and spring onion. Hanoi cooks it with catfish or snakehead, often with turmeric.
origin: Hanoi. The Đỗ family has cooked it on Chả Cá street since 1871.
howToEat: At the table, with spring onion and dill.
The fish is catfish or snakehead, marinated, often in turmeric, then grilled or fried and finished in butter with dill and green onion.
where: Đường Thành. Chả Cá Thăng Long is at 6B Đường Thành, and the same name is also given at 19–21–31 Đường Thành.
seoTitle: Cha ca — Hanoi grilled fish with dill
seoDescription: Cha ca in Hanoi is marinated catfish, grilled, then finished at the table with spring onion and dill, on Duong Thanh.
